SELECT 
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.has_triple = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*)) * 100
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, 
         MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_triple
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) T1;

SELECT 
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.has_triple = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100) / COUNT(*) 
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, 
         MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_triple
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) T1;

SELECT 
    c.client_id, 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT 
    T1.client_id, 
    CAST((strftime('%Y', '1998-12-31') - strftime('%Y', T1.birth_date)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', '1998-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', T1.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id
WHERE T3.type = 'gold' AND T2.type = 'OWNER';
